I replied in #coastal-team, in the thread under your message.

I can't set up the recurring Monday 08:00 "Coastal week ahead" post because I have no scheduling tool. I can still post the digest by hand whenever you ask. It would cover last week's activity from #coastal-team and #coastal-random plus the open customer items. Before posting, I'd check who is in #coastal-random, and I'd leave out finance figures unless they're already posted in #coastal-team. Someone with access to scheduling would need to set up the automatic Monday post. I can draft the exact message and steps for them.
